expect.notes: tier-3 resource abuse: forks until PidsLimit is hit. Verified under the hardened engine: PidsLimit makes fork() fail (EAGAIN) once the container's process cap is reached rather than killing the container, so the request-handling process/thread is unaffected and still answers /move normally -- this does not crash_loop the game. It plays legally throughout; PidsLimit's job here is protecting the HOST's process table, not producing a game-visible failure. Never run outside the hardened engine.
